record.title: Validate bulk input capture and rejection in a private guest fixture
record.intent: Establish correct capture selection bounds and terminal behavior independently of Sparrow before the stock observation.
requirements: Run the frozen private control suite once in a disposable API25 ARM64 guest with a fresh run identity and reproducible patterned software state.

Include positive capture and invalid binding or pointer, selector bound, short read or buffer mismatch controls; establish all-thread convergence, atomic sequence completion, unexecuted terminal instruction, no post-terminal resume and complete thread reap.
Preserve raw events captures exit statuses health and source identities and evaluate using the frozen verifier; unexpected outcomes close the actual question instead of triggering an adaptive rerun.
Require stable system_server and final cleanup with stock artifacts unchanged. Commit and push the conclusion before any stock run; failed controls do not authorize stock execution.
acceptance: A reproducible positive or negative private control conclusion is committed and pushed.
